title: Coefficient-field section for a separable residue field
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a complete local $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] whose residue field $\kappa=R/\mathfrak m$ is separable over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Then there is a $k$-algebra map $\sigma:\kappa\to R$ such that the composite $\kappa\xrightarrow{\sigma}R\to R/\mathfrak m=\kappa$ is the identity.

proof.text: By Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable, the separable algebraic residue extension κ/k is formally étale, hence formally smooth. This is the Mathlib lifting result attached to [lem-exc-separable-algebraic-square-zero-lifting]; no finite-dimensional or finite-type hypothesis is used.

source.place: Tag 0C34, lemma-lift-residue-field, first two sentences of the proof.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib Algebra.FormallySmooth.exists_mkₐ_comp_eq_of_isAdicComplete to the identity k-algebra map of κ = R/m, with ideal m and complete target R. It produces σ : κ →ₐ[k] R such that the quotient algebra map composed with σ is the identity. Taking underlying ring homomorphisms yields the required equation for IsLocalRing.residue. This Mathlib theorem constructs the compatible lifts to R/m^n and takes their inverse limit, so the general adic formal-smoothness and closed-ideal lifting lemmas are unnecessary. The whole Lean proof uses only Mathlib and has five lines; it closes this node directly rather than creating another lifting node (stages/1-dag.md §2).

source.place: Tag 0C34, lemma-lift-residue-field, last sentence, specialized to the zero source ideal and identical target ideals; Mathlib/RingTheory/Smooth/AdicCompletion.lean, exists_mkₐ_comp_eq_of_isAdicComplete.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0C34, lemma-lift-residue-field proof; the complete-target lift is supplied directly by Mathlib Algebra.FormallySmooth.exists_mkₐ_comp_eq_of_isAdicComplete.

split_report.summary: Split Tag 0C34 into the formal-smoothness reduction for the zero ideal and the application of the existing adic formal-smooth lifting theorem to the maximal ideal of the complete local algebra. This proves the separable algebraic specialization of Tag 0C34 encoded by the statement’s cited definition; Tag 0C34 itself allows general separable extensions. In step 2 the required containment concerns the image of the zero source ideal, not the image of the whole source field.

lean.statement: theorem exists_separable_residueField_section (k : Type u) (R : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R] [Algebra.IsSeparable k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)] : ∃ σ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField R →ₐ[k] R, (IsLocalRing.residue R).comp σ.toRingHom = RingHom.id (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
